name: bytedance/seed-2.1-pro
description: Seed 2.1 Pro is the larger of the two models in ByteDance Seed's Seed2.1 family, offered as Doubao-Seed-2.1-Pro through Doubao and Volcano Engine. ByteDance built Seed2.1 for real-world productivity: multi-step general agent work such as planning, document processing and tool use, end-to-end coding from requirement analysis to validation, and computer-use tasks. It also brings strong image, document and long-video understanding, and Seed 2.1 Turbo is the smaller sibling.
